t: # Short Obligatory Prayer ## To be recited once in twenty-four hours, at noon. Neci Yagirwa Nnamahanga, manyirire oku wandemire mpu nkumanye na nkuharamye. Bunola nyemire obuzamba bwani n’Obuhashe bwawe, obukenyi bwani n’Obugale bwawe. Wêne Nnamahanga nta wundi, we burhabale omu mbaka, we Nnamubaho.
